in_marathi.name: Padvi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Padvi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Padvi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'pad' which means 'foot'. It is a diminutive form of the name Padmini, which means 'lotus-footed'. In Hindu mythology, Padvi is associated with Goddess Lakshmi, who is depicted with lotus feet. This name is believed to bring blessings of prosperity, wealth, and good fortune.
